title: Understanding the Model
text: The model given is $$f(x)=\theta_0+\theta_1 {veg}^2$$. This means that the total is predicted based on a constant term $$\theta_0$$ and a term that depends on the square of the vegetables bought, scaled by $$\theta_1$$.

title: Analyzing the Data
text: Look at the scatter plot of total versus veg. Notice the trend as the amount of vegetables increases. How does this trend help you determine the sign of $$\theta_1$$?
